# Sentinela — llms.txt
> Open-source application-logic monitoring in Python. Detects application rule violations and data inconsistencies across databases/APIs by tracking each affected entity until resolved. Complements Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog (system health) by answering "is the application behaving correctly?".

## Docs
- [Home](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/) — what Sentinela does, search/update/is_solved cycle
- [When to use Sentinela](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/when_to_use_sentinela/) — vs Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog, rule of thumb, combined setups
- [Real Use Cases](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/real_use_cases/) — production stories from payments processing and data engineering
- [Overview](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/overview/) — architecture: controller, executors, monitors, issues, alerts
- [Building a Monitor](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/monitor/) — search/update/is_solved contract
- [Monitor lifecycle](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/monitor_lifecycle/) — scheduling, tracking, auto-resolve
- [Example Monitors](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/example_monitors/) — runnable examples
- [Querying databases](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/querying/) — DATABASE_USERS, await query("users", sql)
- [Validating a monitor](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/monitor_validating/) — local validation before registering
- [Registering a monitor](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/monitor_registering/) — CLI/API registration
- [Configuration](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/configuration/) — env vars and options
- [How to run](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/how_to_run/) — single-container, scalable, Kubernetes
- [CLI](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/command_line_interface/) — command line interface
- [HTTP server](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/http_server/) — HTTP API
- [Monitoring Sentinela](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/monitoring_sentinela/) — Prometheus metrics
- [Plugins](https://gabrielsalla.github.io/sentinela/plugins/plugins/) — AWS, Postgres, ODBC, Slack, ntfy, custom
